__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source that scrapes PatchMon /metrics

description: Patch status of the hosts monitored by PatchMon, from its Prometheus exporter (/metrics).

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Prometheus `up` of the targets that served PatchMon metrics in the last day. Down means the last scrape failed: PatchMon is unreachable, or the exporter is turned off in Settings → Metrics (it then answers 503).

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: Hosts monitored by PatchMon that match the filters.

panels.title: Need updates
panels.description: Hosts with at least one pending package update (regular or security).

panels.title: Need security
panels.description: Hosts with at least one pending security update.

panels.title: Need reboot
panels.description: Hosts that report a pending reboot.

panels.title: Offline
panels.description: Active hosts that have not reported for 3× the agent update interval. Computed by PatchMon for all its hosts: the OS and host filters do not apply.

panels.title: Pending updates
panels.description: Pending package updates, summed over hosts: a package pending on 10 hosts counts 10.

panels.title: Up to date
panels.description: Share of hosts with no pending package update.

panels.title: Free of security updates
panels.description: Share of hosts with no pending security update.

panels.title: Reporting
panels.description: Share of hosts that are not offline. Computed by PatchMon for all its hosts: the OS and host filters do not apply.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: Hosts that need updates, security updates or a reboot, and offline hosts. Offline is computed by PatchMon for all its hosts: the OS and host filters do not apply to it.

panels.title: Pending updates
panels.description: Package updates waiting, summed over hosts: a package pending on 10 hosts counts 10.

panels.title: Distinct packages to update
panels.description: Distinct packages with a pending update anywhere in the fleet: a package pending on 10 hosts counts 1. Computed by PatchMon for all its hosts: the OS and host filters do not apply.

panels.title: Operating systems
panels.description: One line per OS version. Pending updates are summed over the hosts of that version.

targets.expr: 1 - sum by (os_type, os_version) ((patchmon_host_pending_updates{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",os_type=~"$os_type",os_version=~"$os_version",name=~"$host"} + patchmon_host_security_updates{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",os_type=~"$os_type",os_version=~"$os_version",name=~"$host"}) > bool 0) / count by (os_type, os_version) (patchmon_host_security_updates{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",os_type=~"$os_type",os_version=~"$os_version",name=~"$host"})

panels.title: Most security updates pending
panels.description: The 15 hosts with the most pending security updates.

panels.title: Most regular updates pending
panels.description: The 15 hosts with the most pending regular (non-security) updates.

panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: One line per host: pending security and regular updates, pending reboot, installed packages. Last report is the time since the agent last reported; it turns orange after 2 hours and red after 3 hours, PatchMon's errored and offline limits with the default 60-minute update interval.

targets.expr: max by (instance, host_id, name, hostname, os_type, os_version) (patchmon_host_security_updates{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",os_type=~"$os_type",os_version=~"$os_version",name=~"$host"})
max by (instance, host_id, name, hostname, os_type, os_version) (patchmon_host_pending_updates{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",os_type=~"$os_type",os_version=~"$os_version",name=~"$host"})
max by (instance, host_id, name, hostname, os_type, os_version) (patchmon_host_pending_reboot{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",os_type=~"$os_type",os_version=~"$os_version",name=~"$host"})
max by (instance, host_id, name, hostname, os_type, os_version) (patchmon_host_installed_packages_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",os_type=~"$os_type",os_version=~"$os_version",name=~"$host"})

time() - max by (instance, host_id, name, hostname, os_type, os_version) (patchmon_host_last_seen_seconds{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",os_type=~"$os_type",os_version=~"$os_version",name=~"$host"} > 0)

list.name: filters
list.label: Filters
list.description: Extra label filters added to every panel query, for example a tenant label your Prometheus or Thanos requires.
